name: ICICI Bank

icici.label: ICICI Bank FY26 results (Free Press Journal)

brief.t: One of India's largest private banks, with 7,511 branches and over 12,000 ATMs (March 2026).
Led by MD & CEO Sandeep Bakhshi since October 2018; RBI approved a new two-year term from 4 Oct 2026 to Oct 2028.
FY 2025-26 net profit was ₹50,147 crore, up about 6%.
Q2 FY27 (Jul–Sep 2026) profit jumped 20.1% to ₹14,843 crore, and Gross NPA fell to 1.20%.
Loans grew 30% and deposits 27.1% in the year to Sep 2026, among the fastest in large banks.

timeline.t: ICICI (Industrial Credit and Investment Corporation of India) set up to fund Indian industry.
ICICI Bank started as a bank.
Parent ICICI Ltd merged into ICICI Bank, creating a universal bank.
Former Cabinet Secretary Pradeep Kumar Sinha became Part-time Chairman.
Bakhshi began a new two-year term as MD & CEO, approved by RBI.

model.how: Like every bank, ICICI earns mainly from the gap between the interest it charges on loans and the interest it pays depositors, plus fees from cards, loans and its insurance, mutual fund and broking group companies.
flow: Bank lends to people and businesses

points: RBI must approve a private bank's CEO. That's why ICICI's 2026 CEO term needed RBI clearance.
Private banks compete with public sector giants like SBI and with fintech payment apps.
Big theme for interviews: banks racing to grow deposits as loan demand rises.

people.name: Sandeep Bakhshi
people.note: Earlier Whole-time Director and COO of ICICI Bank, and MD & CEO of ICICI Prudential Life. Current term runs to Oct 2028.

people.name: Pradeep Kumar Sinha

points.t: Loans up 30% to ₹18.32 lakh cr; deposits up 27.1% to ₹20.50 lakh cr.

numbers.say: ICICI Bank grew its profit 20% last quarter while its bad loans fell to just 1.2% of all loans.

rivals.note: Among private banks, ICICI Bank is second to HDFC Bank in profit.

network.local: ICICI Bank opened 528 new branches in FY26, many in smaller cities and rural areas, where branch banking and sales roles are often based.

employer.note: From the FY 2025-26 annual report. The bank opened 528 branches while its headcount fell, a sign of more automation and productivity.

csr.t: ICICI Bank's CSR is run mainly through the ICICI Foundation for Inclusive Growth, focused on skill training, rural livelihoods and healthcare.

s.t: Strong growth: Q2 FY27 profit up 20.1%

frameworks.note: Framework views are analysis built from the verified facts on this page, not company statements.

glossary.Net profit: What is left after all costs, provisions and taxes. The bank's final earnings.
glossary.Net Interest Income: Interest earned on loans minus interest paid on deposits. A bank's main earning.
glossary.Net interest margin: Net Interest Income as a % of the bank's interest-earning assets. Shows how profitable lending is.
glossary.Gross NPA: Non-Performing Asset: a loan not repaid for 90+ days. Gross NPA is the % of all loans that have gone bad.
glossary.Net NPA: Bad loans after subtracting the money already set aside (provisions) for them. Lower is better.
glossary.CASA ratio: Share of deposits in Current and Savings accounts. These pay little interest, so a higher CASA means cheaper funds.
glossary.Capital adequacy ratio: The bank's own capital compared with the risk in its loans. RBI requires a minimum; higher means safer.
glossary.Provisions: Money set aside from profit to cover loans that may not be repaid.
glossary.Deposits: Money customers keep with the bank in savings, current and fixed deposit accounts.
glossary.Advances: Loans given by the bank to customers and businesses.
glossary.Dividend: Part of the profit paid to shareholders, per share.
glossary.Treasury gains: Profit from buying and selling bonds and other investments. It can swing a lot each quarter.
glossary.Attrition: The % of employees who leave in a year. Also called employee turnover.
glossary.RBI: Reserve Bank of India, which regulates all banks in India.
glossary.KYC: Know Your Customer: checking a customer's identity before opening an account.
glossary.MSME: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: small businesses that banks lend to.
glossary.Cross-sell: Selling an extra product (like a credit card) to an existing customer.
glossary.Public sector bank: A bank where the Government of India owns the majority of shares.
glossary.BRSR: Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report: an official yearly report on people, environment and governance that big listed companies must publish.

skills: Basics of RBI rules and Basel III
Finance.tip: Know Gross vs Net NPA, why CASA lowers a bank's cost of funds, and the bank's latest profit.

Marketing.tip: Think about reaching young and semi-urban customers through mobile and branch campaigns.

HR.tip: Banks hire thousands every year. Ideas to reduce early attrition and train people for digital work will impress.

Sales.tip: Expect role-play: 'Sell me a savings account' or 'Convince a shopkeeper to open a current account.'

Operations.tip: Show you understand KYC, turnaround time and how automation reduces errors.

Role knowledge, the bank and HR questions

Finance.q: Why did ICICI Bank's profit grow faster than its interest margin?
Finance.a: Profit rose 20.1% in Q2 FY27 thanks to strong loan growth and lower provisions, even though the net interest margin fell to 4.18%.

Finance.q: What is Net NPA, and what is ICICI Bank's?
Finance.a: Bad loans after subtracting money already set aside for them. ICICI Bank's Net NPA was 0.30% in Sep 2026.
It shows the bank's cushion against losses. ICICI Bank's was 17.18% in March 2026, well above RBI's minimum.

Marketing.q: How would you attract young customers to ICICI Bank?
Marketing.a: Mobile-first onboarding, student and first-salary accounts, and a smooth app experience, with offers linked to UPI and cards.

Marketing.q: ICICI opened 528 branches in FY26. How would you market a new branch in a small town?
Marketing.a: Local events, shopkeeper current accounts, farmer and gold loan camps, and messaging in the local language.

HR.q: ICICI's headcount fell while branches grew. How would you keep staff motivated?
HR.a: Clear growth paths, reskilling for digital work, recognition, and workload balancing across branches.

HR.q: How would you onboard hundreds of new branch staff quickly?
HR.a: Standard training modules, buddy systems, digital learning, and 30-60-90 day goals.

Sales.q: Sell me an ICICI Bank savings account.
Sales.a: Ask about needs first, then link app, UPI, debit card and sweep-FD features to them. Close with a clear next step.

Operations.q: How would you reduce loan processing time?
Operations.a: Digital KYC, pre-approved offers, fewer manual checks, and tracking turnaround time at each step.

Other.q: What do you know about ICICI Bank?
Other.a: India's second-largest private bank: ₹50,147 cr profit in FY26, 7,511 branches, led by Sandeep Bakhshi.

gd.for: ICICI's headcount fell by 6,633 in FY26 while branches grew.
gd.against: New roles in sales, technology and advisory keep growing.

gd.t: Private banks vs public sector banks: who serves India better?
gd.for: Private banks are faster and more digital.
gd.against: SBI earned the highest profit in FY26 and reaches the most people.

avoid: Don't confuse ICICI Bank with ICICI Prudential Life or ICICI Lombard; they are separate listed companies.
Don't call it a public sector bank. It's private.
Don't quote old NPA figures; Gross NPA is now 1.20% (Sep 2026).
